{{Quote|I can't believe we couldn't get arena tickets for this match! Now we'll have to watch the duel on a view screen.|The spectator at the Taris dueling ring|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
During the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''dueling fan''' lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. In [[3956 BBY]], she was unable to get tickets for a dueling match in the [[Upper City Cantina]] and was forced to watch it on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] dueling fan lived on the Outer Rim city world of Taris during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire.<ref name="KOTOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', in which the dueling fan appears, in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> she and [[Unidentified male dueling fan|another fan]] were unable to get tickets for a match between [[Deadeye Duncan]] and [[Gerlon Two-Fingers]] in the [[Upper City Cantina]]'s [[Taris dueling ring|dueling ring]]. The other fan claimed that missing a duel between Duncan and Gerlon wasn't something to care about, but she told him to stop complaining and watch the [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] as it was about to start. The two patrons began watching as the [[Unidentified announcer|announcer]] introduced the duelists and the duel began. Upon pulling out his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], Duncan dropped it and was defeated by Gerlon within seconds. The announcer assured the audience that he was just unconscious, and the duel came to an end.<ref name="KOTOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
Former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who had [[Amnesia/Legends|lost]] his memories and had the personality of a [[Republic soldier]], survived the [[Attack on the Endar Spire|attack]] on the [[Endar Spire]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and eventually found himself at the [[Upper City]] [[Cantina/Legends|Cantina]]. After talking to [[Ajuur]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], he agreed to become a duelist under the name of the "[[Mysterious Stranger]]." He approached the dueling fan, who talked about the other duelists. After Revan had won several matches, the woman became a fan of him, and mentioned such when she saw him again.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I love watching Ice fight! She proves this isn't just a man's game!|The dueling fan to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The dueling fan was a Human female with short [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], dark skin, and gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

The woman spent time in the Upper City Cantina where she enjoyed watching duels in person, and was frustrated when she was unable to get tickets. Her favorite duelist was the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Twitch (Rodian)|Twitch]], as she liked how wild he was. She also liked watching the female duelist [[Ice (duelist)|Ice]], feeling that she proved dueling wasn't exclusive to men. The fan believed that Deadeye Duncan was terrible and wondered why he didn't just give up.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Equipment==
The woman wore an orange and yellow [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]] with a green and mauve [[Belt/Legends|belt]]. She also wore black pants and yellow knee length [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The dueling fan appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. She appears in a cutscene when the player enters a room in the Upper City Cantina. Additional interactions are optional and no dialogue affects plot, quest, or alignment.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Her dialogue changes when the player wins dueling matches and when they become champion. She will also remark if they kill [[Gorse Bendak|Bendak Starkiller]] in a death match, which gives [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points<ref name="KOTOR" /> and is thus considered non-canon in the [[Star Wars Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Canon">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes the light side ending as the canon version of events.</ref>
